description: Create or update a Cloud Functions action (PUT, API v2.1 (/ncf/api/v2) — idempotent; the same call updates an existing action). type selects the action kind and CANNOT be changed after creation: basic (default) | web | sequence | sequence-web. basic/web: exec_kind, exec_code and exec_main are required; limits_timeout/limits_memory default to 60000 ms / 128 MB; on platform=vpc the action MUST be attached to a VPC + Subnet (vpc_no, subnet_no). sequence/sequence-web: pass exec_components as ['{packageName}/{actionName}', ...] (use '-' for unpackaged actions); exec_kind is forced to 'sequence'. Runtimes (exec_kind): nodejs:22, python:3.13, java, java:21, swift:3.1.1, php:7.3, go:1.19, dotnet:2.2, custom image. Deprecated since 2025-09-18 and refused for NEW actions: nodejs:6, nodejs:8, nodejs:12, nodejs:16, python:3.6, python:3.7, python:3.11, php:7.1, go:1.11. java/dotnet accept only base64 binaries (.jar / .zip) with exec_binary=true. 'custom image' requires exec_imageUri ('{registryName}/{imageName}:{tag}'). Use dryRun=true to see the exact request without calling the API.

actionName.description: Action name: 1-50 chars of letters, digits, '-' and '_'; must not start with '-'; unique across packages/actions/triggers

allowDeprecatedRuntime.description: Send a deprecated exec_kind anyway (the API is documented to refuse new actions on them)

custom_options.description: web types only: let the action set HTTP response headers (sent as 'custom-options')

dryRun.description: Preview the request without calling the API

exec_binary.description: true if exec_code is a base64-encoded file (required for java/dotnet: .jar / .zip)

exec_code.description: Source code (exec_binary=false) or base64-encoded file (exec_binary=true). Required for basic/web unless exec_kind is 'custom image'.

exec_components.description: sequence/sequence-web only: actions to run in order, each '{packageName}/{actionName}'

exec_imageUri.description: Custom Image runtime only: '{registryName}/{imageName}:{tag}' (tag defaults to latest)

exec_kind.description: Runtime, e.g. 'python:3.13', 'nodejs:22', 'java:21', 'custom image'. Ignored for sequence types (forced to 'sequence'). Supported: nodejs:22, python:3.13, java, java:21, swift:3.1.1, php:7.3, go:1.19, dotnet:2.2, custom image

exec_main.description: Entry function name, e.g. 'main'. Required for basic/web.

limits_timeout.description: Max execution time in ms, 500-300000 (default 60000). basic/web only.

parameters.description: Default parameters as a {key: value} JSON object (basic/web only). Precedence: runtime params > trigger params > action params > package params.

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

raw_http.description: web types only: pass the raw HTTP request to the action (sent as 'raw-http')

subnet_no.description: Subnet number to attach (REQUIRED for basic/web on platform=vpc; see ncloud_list_subnets)

type.description: Action type (query parameter). Cannot be changed once created.

vpc_no.description: VPC number to attach (REQUIRED for basic/web on platform=vpc; see ncloud_list_vpcs)

name: ncloud_functions_create_action
